title: Merged livestock graph at 5a6d0be7eab56a192522fc4c2b2556a2be2bbbba
supported_claim: Complete current closures, hierarchy, labels, definitions, semantic types, and material-facet usage can be audited deterministically from merged governed outputs.
limitation: Local graph records current ERA decisions; it cannot establish external biological or chemical truth.

title: AOM semantic schema
supported_claim: materialComponent is current superproperty of ingredientPart; primaryConstituent identifies a chemically defined constituent central to material identity; quantitative composition is represented separately.
limitation: Schema expresses current design and remains subject to this review and downstream compatibility planning.

title: FoodOn core repository
supported_claim: FoodOn separates food materials and products from anatomical and taxonomic origins and reuses Plant Ontology, UBERON, ChEBI, and NCBITaxon.
limitation: FoodOn covers human and domesticated-animal food broadly and does not prescribe ERA feed-product or browser structure.

title: FoodOn editor ontology commit c5035015de540ba4f4210fd0e24d3909d6fb2037
supported_claim: Pinned FoodOn source contains food material, food product, seed part, seed germ, seed bran, and germ-and-bran classes usable for reproducible comparison.
limitation: Several seed-part terms derive from LanguaL and mix anatomical wording with process-defined fractions; they are comparison evidence rather than an exact hierarchy template.

title: FoodOn and LanguaL design
supported_claim: FoodOn uses independent facets and object properties for source, ingredient, and added substance; unknown or inapplicable catch-all values are avoided under open-world semantics.
limitation: Design concerns FoodOn migration from LanguaL and does not decide ERA component predicates or exact feed-material identities.

title: CHEBI:24431 chemical entity
supported_claim: Chemical entity is an identity-level chemistry class including molecular entities, parts, and chemical substances.
limitation: ChEBI does not model feed composition measurements or feed-product authorization.

title: CHEBI:59999 chemical substance
supported_claim: Chemical substance is a chemical entity and is defined as a portion of matter of constant composition.
limitation: Not every ERA constituent category or processed mixture is a ChEBI chemical substance; exact mappings require concept-level review.

title: Plant Ontology scope and pinned source
supported_claim: Plant Ontology provides cross-species plant anatomical entities and distinguishes whole plants, multi-tissue structures, organs, tissues, and developmental stages.
limitation: Common feed terms such as hull
column10: and germ may not be exact anatomical synonyms across taxa or processing contexts.

title: PO:0009089 endosperm
supported_claim: Endosperm is a portion of nutritive plant tissue in a seed and therefore is a true anatomical component.
limitation: Does not imply that a separated commercial endosperm fraction is identical to the anatomical tissue without process and purity evidence.

title: PO:0009009 plant embryo
supported_claim: Plant embryo is a whole plant participating in embryo stage; germ is only a related synonym, not an exact synonym.
limitation: Does not support treating every feed-industry germ fraction as exact plant embryo.

title: Uberon anatomy ontology through EBI OLS
supported_claim: Uberon provides cross-species animal anatomy including liver UBERON:0002107 and viscus UBERON:0002075.
limitation: Viscera is a collective/plural feed descriptor and is not automatically exact-equivalent to singular viscus.

title: Consolidated Catalogue of feed materials 02013R0068-20220724
supported_claim: Maize bran is a flour or semolina manufacturing product containing outer skins, germ fragments, and endosperm particles; maize germ is a manufacturing product containing predominantly germ plus outer skins and endosperm.
limitation: Regulatory product descriptions establish feed-material identity and process provenance but do not define universal anatomical classes or ontology relations.

title: Straw
supported_claim: Straw is a crop residue of dry stems and leaves left after harvest and is broader-classified under crop residues.
limitation: AGROVOC is a thesaurus; broader relations do not by themselves provide formal OWL identity axioms.

title: Crop residues
supported_claim: Crop residues are organic matter left after crop harvest; stover and straw are narrower products.
limitation: NALT classification does not decide ERA feed-product role or exact source-specific material hierarchy.

title: Stover
supported_claim: Stover is typed as a product and placed beneath crop residues, with corn stover narrower.
limitation: NALT provides no definition on this record and cannot establish exact composition for every crop stover.
